decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a durable, high-quality backpack for everyday use. Maxpedition is a well-regarded brand for longevity. The Prepared Citizen Classic v2.0 (prod_backpacks_038) stands out because of its high 4.7 rating and its discrete, non-tactical design, which makes it versatile for work and travel. While the ZOMAKE (prod_backpacks_173) is a great budget-friendly packable option, it doesn't offer the protection I need for daily gear. The Falcon-III (prod_backpacks_096) is a superior bag but is more than twice the price, making the Prepared Citizen the most logical purchase for quality and value.
